result: Design note + test-only prototype: eager caller-address attribution through the loader's module map with a handler-address net at unload, opt-in carried by a non-default Liella-only symbol version that glibc's loader refuses at load (probed); no product change
head: 9b07b05eb

gate.affected: prototype tests 8 passed / 0 failed; clippy and static clean; plants 9/9 caught

rulings.item: Opt-in public interface: Liella-only version node (e.g. LIELLA_OWNER_1) as non-default exports of atexit, at_quick_exit, pthread_atfork plus a link-stub directory
rulings.recommendation: adopt in the phase 14 product story with a decision record and user docs
keep the archive as the default while two-way compatibility is a default; deprecate it by link warnings and reports for opted-in distributions only

rulings.item: Extend the handler-address net to stub-registered entries
rulings.recommendation: no for now; if yes it needs a differences row and a COMPAT flag restoring owner-only finalisation

informational: Liella's ld.so has no dlopen/dlclose or runtime module map before phase 14, so costs are modelled and estimated, not counted on a product
ELF-note and dynamic-tag markers rejected by reasoning (not probed): glibc's loader is not expected to refuse an unknown note or tag
improvement: A first-run clippy failure on test-file lints cost a plants rerun: briefs for prototype stories could name the standard test-file lint allow line
next_step: Owner rulings on the opt-in interface and end state; then a phase 14 story builds (a)+(b) on the loader map
